intro: Prestique connects your AI agent to Zenoti's API so it works from the same availability information your team sees. When a caller asks about open appointment slots, the agent pulls that data directly from Zenoti. You keep the software you already use.

The agent answers calls when your team can't — after hours and when the line is busy. Anything it shouldn't handle is passed to your team with a summary of the call. Every call is recorded with a transcript and a note of what the caller needed.
metaDescription: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents that work with Zenoti. Answers calls after hours, checks availability, and hands off to your team.
subhead: Prestique builds AI voice and text agents for salons and spas that run Zenoti. The agent works with Zenoti rather than replacing it.
